title: Full pipeline e2e test
objective: Cover parse → IR build → lowering → optimizer → codegen → run → result checks in a single end-to-end test.

plan_assets.asset_description: Example LaTeX input for full pipeline test

implementation_steps: Write LaTeX input with MVP mechanics directives
Parse → ProblemIR → ElementIR → ContractionPlan → Taichi source
Execute generated solver on structured mesh
Check displacement results against expected tolerances
acceptance_criteria: One command runs full pipeline and asserts expected tolerances
All pipeline stages execute without error

cases: Full pipeline: LaTeX → solve → check results
Pipeline error messages for invalid input

risks: E2e test will be slow (Taichi compilation) — mark with @pytest.mark.slow and @pytest.mark.e2e
